column1: # Partition table for MechanicalDogUpgrade / firmware
# Why a custom table instead of the ESP-IDF default (partitions_singleapp.csv):
#   The board has 4 MB of flash
column2: but the default table gives the app only 1 MB.

column1: #   Once P5 pulled in WiFi + esp_http_server + lwIP + mbedtls
#   92.9% of that 1 MB (974425 of 1048576 bytes) -- about 74 KB of headroom left
#   which is not enough for the P6 arm and telemetry work still to come.
# Why NVS keeps its offset and size on purpose:
#   nvs stays at 0x9000 with 0x6000 (24 KB) and factory still starts at 0x10000
#   so growing the app partition does NOT move NVS.  The calibration and WiFi
#   settings already stored on the board therefore survive this change; only the
#   app image is rewritten.  (app_config_nvs.h documents the same 0x9000/24 KB.)
# What this gives up:
#   There are no ota_0 / ota_1 slots
